name: aboleth
lore:
In the crushing depths of forgotten seas and subterranean lakes dwells a horror from a time before time, the aboleth. These ancient, eel-like aberrations possess a chilling intellect and a hunger for dominion that stretches back to the dawn of existence. Their cities, built in defiance of the natural world, pulse with a dark, alien energy that warps the minds of those who stray too close. 

Imagine the chill of the deep, the oppressive silence broken only by the rhythmic pulse of unseen organs. Aboleths, with their lamprey mouths and eyes stacked atop each other, glide through the water, their bodies slick with a mucus that spells doom for air-breathers. They remember epochs long past, the rise and fall of civilizations, and the fleeting lives of gods. To cross an aboleth is to invite not just death, but the enslavement of your mind and the consumption of your very essence, adding your memories to their endless, growing repository of knowledge and malice.

These beings see themselves as the rightful inheritors of the world, and they weave intricate plots to reclaim what they believe is theirs. They manipulate lesser races, turning them into mindless servitors through a horrifying transformation. The kuo-toa, driven mad by their proximity, often become willing slaves, worshipping the aboleths as gods. Beware the depths, for in the murky darkness, the aboleths dream of a world remade in their terrible image.
